mmtiled.host_contract: For each configured (i,j,k) tile, accumulate C[ii,jj] += A[ii,kk] * B_transposed[jj,kk] over clipped tile bounds.
mmtiled.topology_contract: Instantiate NUM_X_CU*NUM_Y_CU engines. Lane (x,y) owns i_start+x modulo NUM_X_CU and j_start+y modulo NUM_Y_CU, with unique coordinate response IDs. Local fair pending arbiters feed the restored two-input read arbiter and singular write/data outputs; counters sum across lanes and completion is the AND reduction.

requirement_probe_semantics.pass: The production RTL satisfies the probed requirement.
requirement_probe_semantics.blocked: The executable probe reached a production RTL mismatch; the family is not complete.
requirement_probe_semantics.infrastructure_failure: The probe could not compile or did not reach its expected self-check.

tutorial_write_backpressure.scenario: hold write_command_buffer_status.alfull across the input pulse, then release
tutorial_write_backpressure.required_result: no command while full; exactly one command with intact halves after release

memcpy_write_only_source.scenario: write-only mode, one element, no read command
memcpy_write_only_source.required_result: one zero-filled write and completion counter one

memcpy_tlb_resume.scenario: read and write streams with max_tlb_cl_requests=1 and three bursts
memcpy_tlb_resume.required_result: one outstanding command per burst and exact 65-element counters

mmtiled_matrix_c_iteration.scenario: zero, single, full, and edge tiles with exact row-major addresses
mmtiled_matrix_c_iteration.required_result: no +4 first-row shift, no extra row, exact job count

mmtiled_matrix_product.scenario: zero, single, full, edge, and repeated transposed-B tile accumulation with read-data/response reorder and command stalls
mmtiled_matrix_product.required_result: aligned full-line reads, exact scalar offsets, clipped bounds, exact partial C writes, write count, and multiply-term count

mmtiled_outer_arbiter_publication.scenario: hold a real legacy-loader request on outer input 0 while engine input 1 is pending and ready[1] is delayed
mmtiled_outer_arbiter_publication.required_result: engine submit and payload remain stable through the delayed arbiter publish edge; the recorded owner is granted exactly once and the external command is published exactly once

mmtiled_write_dispatch.scenario: hold write alfull across multiple cycles after a lane command is pending
mmtiled_write_dispatch.required_result: pending command/data remain stable, no external valid is emitted while blocked, accepted command/data pulse exactly once, all three pending valids clear together, and exactly one response is consumed per dispatch
